newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber ends flat ahead of Japan holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber ends flat ahead of Japan holiday.

text.p: Rubber futures closed virtually unchanged on Wednesday in dull trade with most dealers sidelined ahead of a holiday in Japan, dealers said.
"Everybody stayed out of the market with the holiday in Japan coming up tomorrow. That's why nothing happened in the market today," a local rubber trader said.
Dealers predict trading will even be more monotonous on Thursday with the Japanese markets shut down for the day. The Tokyo and Kobe rubber markets will reopen on Friday.
"It will even be more miserable tomorrow with nobody interested in any action whatsoever," another trader said.
At around 0945 GMT, November RSS3 was seen at 123.00-124.00 U.S. cents a kg from 123.00 cents.
November RSS1 was seen at 175.00-176.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24-$1.25) a kg from yesterday's settlement of 175.00 cents.
December TSR20 was seen at 173.00-174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.22-$1.23) a kg against the previous 173.50 cents.
